title: Steinman's UFO Crash book: Aztec 1948, Eric Henry Wang and "HAK"

as_told.title: Eric Henry Wang and the Aztec crash
as_told.place_text: Aztec, New Mexico; Wright Field; Kirtland AFB

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says he read a book by a UFO researcher, William Steinman, about a flying saucer said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948, and that it describes Eric Henry Wang, a scientist brought to the US after World War Two under Operation Paperclip, a program that recruited German experts, who ran special projects at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio. Michels says Steinman figured out that Wang reported to someone called "HAK", meaning Henry Kissinger, later a top US diplomat, and in another telling he puts the claim in the mouth of Wang's wife, Maria, who said her husband worked on UFOs and his boss was Kissinger. If true, it would tie one of America's most famous statesmen to secret work on crashed saucers.
